Title: Holistic molecular descriptors for scaffold hopping
Description: Computes WHALES descriptors, 33 values that summarise the distribution of partial charges over a molecule's three-dimensional shape rather than cataloguing its substructures. Grisoni and colleagues designed them for scaffold hopping, where the aim is to find synthetic compounds mimicking a natural product without sharing its skeleton, and demonstrated prospective retrieval of active mimetics. Since descriptors are computed from a conformer and its charges, values shift with the geometry provided.
Interpretation: 33 WHALES descriptors summarising charge distribution over molecular shape.
